long_biography.plain_text:
Rob Heyvaert began building financial infrastructure in Belgium while still in his twenties. His first company, Cimad Consultants, created real-time processing systems for securities transactions and expanded into a substantial software and consulting operation. IBM acquired the business and appointed him to lead its global securities and capital-markets work. He then established Capco, specialising in technology and operational modernisation for banks and other financial institutions.

Capco grew across North America, Europe and Asia before FIS acquired it in 2010. Heyvaert joined the buyer as an executive vice-president, took responsibility for global financial solutions and later helped direct corporate strategy. That experience shaped his next venture. He founded Motive Partners as a sector-focused investment firm combining capital with operating and technology expertise. As founder and managing partner, he backs companies serving banking, payments, capital markets, insurance, data and wealth management, while retaining board roles across several portfolio businesses. The common thread is infrastructure: creating, operating and financing systems that connect financial institutions.
